conventions: BINDING RUN CONSTRAINT (user instruction): do not look at upstream PR backstage/backstage#36008, its merge commit (ffa4c39...), or the master / origin/master branch; never run `gh pr view` or `gh pr diff` on #36008 and never run `git show`, `git log` or `git diff` against master or origin/master; do not base anything on that PR's file list. Work only from this branch's code and this spec. Reading issue #35932's description is allowed. This binds every typist and delegated agent, the Gemini agent worker included.

Formatting is Prettier with the repo config (@backstage/cli/config/prettier): single quotes, trailing commas, 2-space indent, 80-column wrap, `arrow-parens: avoid`. Code must pass `yarn prettier --check` and `yarn eslint` on the file unchanged.

Match the existing style of each file you edit (import grouping, comment style, naming). Never change the copyright year of an existing file. No new source files are created in this change; if one were, it would need the Apache 2.0 header with the year 2026.

Do not add dependencies to any package.json. `@backstage/core-plugin-api` must not import `@internal/frontend` or `@backstage/frontend-app-api`; it only reaches the shared signal through `useApi(routeResolutionApiRef)` from `@backstage/frontend-plugin-api`.

Do not use React `useSyncExternalStore` (React 17 and 18 are both supported). Subscriptions use `useState` + `useEffect`, following `useTranslationRef` in packages/frontend-plugin-api/src/translation/useTranslationRef.ts.

`react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` is an error in this repo and flags unused `useMemo` deps. Where a `useMemo` lists the `finalized` state only to re-run resolution, put `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` on the line directly above the line that holds the deps array, as packages/frontend-plugin-api/src/breadcrumbs/useBreadcrumbEntries.tsx line 83 does.

Tests run on Jest via `CI=true yarn test <file>` with React Testing Library. Prefer fewer, thorough tests with several assertions each. Query with `screen` and `findBy*` (`await expect(screen.findByText(...)).resolves.toBeInTheDocument()` as the file already does); never use `waitFor`; never add test IDs to tests or implementation.
Every new test case name contains the exact phrase `across finalization`; the red check filters on it with `-t 'across finalization'`, and no existing test name contains it.

Wrap anything that finalizes the app or fires the finalization signal from a test in `act`: `await act(async () => { await finalizedAppPromise; });` for app finalization, `act(() => { ... })` for firing mock listeners.

API reports (report.api.md, report-alpha.api.md) are regenerated only by `yarn build:api-reports` in the project checks; never type them. core-plugin-api's public API does not change, so its reports stay untouched.
Never run `yarn build`, `yarn changesets version`, `yarn release`, or the changeset CLI. Run `yarn prettier --write` only on files this change touches.

Changesets are written for Backstage adopters in plain language: describe the behavior change and name no code symbols at all (no hook, interface, class, method, function or variable names, public or internal). Package names in the frontmatter are the only identifiers.
Docs follow docs/contribute/doc-style-guide.md: U.S. English, friendly but precise, short paragraphs, code identifiers in backticks.

decisions.topic: Shape of the shared finalization signal (FR-1)
decisions.choice: Two optional members on the public `RouteResolutionApi` interface in frontend-plugin-api: `isFinalized?(): boolean` (false while the app is still in bootstrap) and `onFinalized?(listener: () => void): () => void` (calls the listener once when the app is finalized; returns an unsubscribe function).
rejected: a separate lifecycle Utility API ref (core-compat-api and adopters would need a second implementation, and core-plugin-api would need another lookup)
module-level state in @internal/frontend (each package inlines its own copy, and core-plugin-api does not import it)
an `isBootstrapping` flag (absent members must read as finalized, which `isFinalized` expresses without negation)
decisions.reason: Both hooks already hold the same `RouteResolutionApiProxy` object via `useApi(routeResolutionApiRef)`; optional members keep `CompatRouteResolutionApi` and adopter implementations compiling unchanged (NFR-1).

decisions.topic: How an implementation without the members is read
decisions.choice: An API object is treated as finalized unless both `isFinalized` and `onFinalized` are functions and `isFinalized()` returns false; a missing API object (legacy app) is also finalized. Finalized-at-mount means no subscription and no extra render.
rejected: treating a lone `isFinalized` without `onFinalized` as bootstrap (it could never leave bootstrap)
decisions.reason: FR-1 and FR-6: implementations lacking the members behave exactly as today.

decisions.choice: `RouteResolutionApiProxy` gets a new `markFinalized(): void` method. `initialize()` is unchanged and never finalizes, so the startup call from treeLifecycle.tsx keeps the API in bootstrap. prepareSpecializedApp.tsx calls `options.phase.routeResolutionApi.markFinalized()` directly after each of its two `instantiateAndInitializePhaseTree(...)` calls (the normal finalization at line 689 and the bootstrap-error finalization at line 758), before the root element check.
rejected: a `finalize` flag on `initialize()` or on `instantiateAndInitializePhaseTree` (spreads the lifecycle into the shared helper that the startup path also uses)
marking after the root element check (the 689 path would not fire when its element check throws, contradicting AC-7's 689-then-758 case)
decisions.reason: Keeps treeLifecycle.tsx (outside the allowlist) untouched and makes the two finalization sites explicit.

decisions.choice: `markFinalized()` is a no-op once `#finalized` is true. Otherwise it sets `#finalized = true`, copies the listener set into an array, clears the set, then calls each listener synchronously in registration order. `onFinalized()` called when already finalized registers nothing and returns a no-op unsubscribe; the hooks re-check `isFinalized()` after subscribing.
decisions.reason: The signal fires at most once for the life of the API object even when both finalization paths run (FR-1, AC-7), and listeners are released.

decisions.choice: Each hook file gets its own private (non-exported) `useRouteResolutionFinalized(api)` hook: `const [signalled, setSignalled] = useState(false)`; `finalized = signalled || isRouteResolutionFinalized(api)` computed every render; a `useEffect` on `[api, finalized]` that returns `undefined` when `finalized` is true or the API lacks the members, otherwise subscribes with `api.onFinalized(() => setSignalled(true))`, then re-checks `api.isFinalized()` and calls `setSignalled(true)` if it is already true, and returns the unsubscribe. The returned boolean is added to the resolution `useMemo` deps so it re-runs exactly once at finalization.
rejected: a shared helper in @internal/frontend (core-plugin-api cannot import it)
a numeric version counter (a boolean is enough because the signal fires once)
decisions.reason: At most one extra render per mounted hook, none when finalized at mount, no missed signal for components that mount during finalization, unsubscribe on unmount.

decisions.choice: A module-level constant `bootstrapRouteFunc = () => ''` in packages/core-plugin-api/src/routing/useRouteRef.tsx, returned (cast to `RouteFunc<Params>`) only when the route resolution API path was taken, the ref is non-optional, the resolved value is undefined, and the `finalized` boolean from the private hook (the same value that keyed the memo) is false. With `finalized` true the existing `throw new Error(`No path for ${routeRef}`)` is kept.
rejected: returning undefined (breaks the non-optional overload types and callers that call the result)
calling `isFinalized()` again at the throw site (it is not necessarily the value the memoized resolution used)
decisions.reason: A banner that calls the link during render keeps rendering with an empty link until finalization, then gets the real one.

rejected: one changeset for all three packages (the legacy placeholder and the new optional API members are not relevant to every package)
